pr_metadata.title: docs(report): IRR setup facts spike — MQ 10.0 Native HA in-region replication (#1103)
pr_metadata.summary: Adds a cited facts report pinning the MQ 10.0 Native HA IRR setup deltas (SyncReplication=Yes + SyncConsistency=Strict in NativeHARecoveryGroup, no NativeHAInstance stanza, default port 9415, strict-sync start-ordering, 10.0 floor, Developer-edition availability) that gate epic .github#227 Tasks 3/4/5.
pr_metadata.notes: Investigation task (no production code) — docs-only, validation green (markdownlint + full pytest 100% cov + audit). Report at docs/reports/2026-09-15-mq10-nativeha-irr-setup-facts-spike.md. IBM 10.0.x sources cached under build/refs/ibm-docs/ (gitignored). Reviewer heads-up: the spike surfaces TWO facts that conflict with the plan and need a design decision before Tasks 3/4/5 build — (1) IBM IRR is a two-node single-instance-per-group topology, NOT two 3-node HA groups as Task 5 assumes; (2) the CRR->IRR delta is two NativeHARecoveryGroup keys, not the single SyncConsistency line the plan's best-known form used. Both are flagged in the report's Implications section.
